The 'texture_anomaly' of the plant (severity 2) is minor but present. I agree with the severity ratings. The `image_text_auditor` confirms the gibberish with low confidence scores (<0.75) and nonsensical strings ('OORHRUY', 'KHAK'), validating the Router's highest-severity finding.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails the core definition of a 'menu' because it lacks readable text listing food items. While the `fine_grained_classifier` identifies it as a 'menu' (likely due to layout/color priors), the `image_text_auditor` proves the content is hallucinated gibberish. Only superficial aesthetic checkpoints (color scheme, branding presence) pass. The lack of semantic functionality drastically reduces alignment.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic text generation failure (gibberish) dominates the artifact score. The text is not just blurry; it is structurally malformed and semantically void. Secondary artifacts include the melting/ambiguous hand in the foreground and slight wavy distortion in the text lines. The background and main board structure are relatively clean, preventing a score of 0.0, but the primary subject (the text) is severely defective.
